cand.title: Process Plant Start Up, Commissioning & Troubleshooting — Geneva
cand.excerpt: Specific future dates and organizer/venue evidence establish a credible mechanism; accessibility and fit require verification.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Jim KADRİ — Training Manager, BlackBird Training Centre, listed current since April 2019: senior programme-routing contact, not a verified hotel signatory. Sara Galea — Trainer Engagement Manager, listed current since January 2025: training-logistics contact; her previous Operations Coordinator–Training role explicitly included venue bookings. Neither profile proves responsibility for this Geneva session or current hotel-contract authority.
findings.futureEdition: Official session page explicitly publishes Monday 25–Friday 29 January 2027, Geneva (Switzerland), in person, open for registration. These are course activity dates, within the requested horizon, not article dates. The page calls this the only Geneva date in 2027. This verifies an announced session, not enrolled demand or guaranteed delivery. No later Geneva edition through June 2028 was located.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specification: a classroom training meeting is a more plausible product match than congress overflow. YOTEL Geneva Lake in Founex could offer a right-sized meeting room, AV and coffee breaks, with optional separately booked accommodation, only if the organizer accepts the La Côte location and participants can reach it. Six meeting rooms and the supplied capacity envelope do not establish this cohort fits: attendance and room layout requirements are unpublished. Do not assume 20–120 bedrooms, a full-house booking, banquet capacity or resort-retreat demand. If the classroom stays in central Geneva, a Founex lodging offer is secondary and requires explicit acceptance of travel arrangements.
findings.venueCommitments: Exact venue: unknown; no named venue or hotel on the edition page. Published city: Geneva, Switzerland. Exact venue region/jurisdiction: unverified. Geneva is the advertised destination, but a Geneva-city versus airport-corridor address cannot be established; no evidence locates it in Founex/Nyon/La Côte, Lausanne or French Pays de Gex. No incumbent hotel commitment identified. Generic FAQ venue statements are not edition-specific commitments.
findings.historicalRotation: No delivered historical Geneva edition or historical host hotel verified. The official course catalogue advertises Istanbul, 25–29 October 2026, but its linked session 129696 currently describes 31 October–4 November 2027. Preserve this inconsistency rather than treating either as proof of a delivered historical edition. Multi-city course scheduling is not evidence of an association congress rotating between destinations.
findings.accommodationSourcing: The official FAQ answers “Do you assist in booking hotel rooms?” with “No, we don’t. We only book our training venues”; it also says “The fees do not include any accommodation or flight ticket.” Therefore the organizer is a meeting-venue sourcing path, not a verified group-housing buyer. Delegate/employer-arranged lodging is an inference from that policy. No edition-specific housing bureau, hotel list, room block or open RFP was found; no hotels can be named as committed. The FAQ also says venues can change: “Yes, we can. We respect your choice and we try to book as close to you as possible.” This is flexibility, not proof that January venue sourcing is open.
findings.organizationStructure: BlackBird describes itself as a UK-based professional training and development company providing customized corporate and professional learning. It owns/markets this course and issues its certificate. This is a commercial training-provider opportunity, not an association congress or a verified PCO/DMC mandate. No separate PCO or housing agency identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: No named incumbent hotel, overflow requirement, published attendance, peak rooms or room nights located. Demand could be below a commercially useful residential group threshold; size remains unknown. The primary commercial limitation is that BlackBird explicitly does not book delegate bedrooms. Unannounced venue does not mean uncontracted venue, and registration-open does not mean hotel-sourcing-open.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact sales@blackbird-training.com, the published session/FAQ routing address, asking for Jim KADRİ or Sara Galea and the person responsible for Geneva venue procurement. Reference OG3277/session 152871 and 25–29 January 2027. First request the exact classroom address, contract status, confirmed cohort size, classroom/AV/coffee-break needs and whether Founex is acceptable. Offer a meeting-room proposal only after those answers; position bedrooms separately as optional delegate/employer bookings. Ask whether a nonexclusive accommodation referral can be shared with registered delegates. Do not describe this as open sourcing or reserve speculative group inventory.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: January 2027 is officially bookable for delegates; hotel procurement accessibility remains unconfirmed. Organizer outreach is justified for training-space availability, but no live hotel RFP or room-block mandate is established. The FAQ includes airport pickup and says a driver takes delegates to their hotel, but it names neither Geneva Airport nor this session’s arrival route. No edition-specific Geneva Airport or La Côte lodging evidence; no Lausanne or French-border venue established.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: develop BlackBird as a repeat training-venue account, not as an annual association rotation. Its general policy of booking training venues and accommodating venue changes supports a relationship-development conversation. No future Geneva course date beyond January 2027, venue tender or annual recurrence is verified. Capture strategy: ask to be considered for subsequently confirmed Geneva-area sessions or bespoke corporate cohorts, with optional individual accommodation referrals.
